about: StarDraft's KPIs (tools/kpi.py, docs/dev/KPI.md). dir: max = the value may be at most the target, min = at least. target null: recorded only. accepted: {version: {kpi: reason}} for a release that ships with a missed target.

startup_ms.name: Start to the first frame (no map)

first_frame_small_ms.name: First frame of a 96 x 96 map

first_frame_large_ms.name: First frame of a 256 x 256 map

paint_layers_p95_ms.name: Paint stroke step on a layer, slowest 5%

working_set_large_mb.name: Working set with a 256 x 256 map

cycles_heap_growth_mb_direct3d12.name: Heap growth, 25 map opens and closes (Direct3D 12)

cycles_gpu_growth_mb_direct3d12.name: Video memory growth, 25 opens and closes (Direct3D 12)

cycles_heap_growth_mb_vulkan.name: Heap growth, 25 map opens and closes (Vulkan)

cycles_gpu_growth_mb_vulkan.name: Video memory growth, 25 opens and closes (Vulkan)

strings_missing_max.name: UI strings missing in a language (most)

block_texts_missing_max.name: Trigger block texts missing in a language (most)

font_symbols.name: Symbols from a font in the code

bare_search_cues.name: Search cues that do not name what they search

files_over_3000_lines.name: Files of more than 3,000 lines (not data tables)

docs_broken_links.name: Links in docs/ to files that are not there
